regime.read: VIX 19.0, level YELLOW. Index is quiet (VIX in the low part of its 2y range, term structure in contango) but option dealers are short gamma (SPY -12.05B, QQQ -7.46B), so moves are amplified both ways. SPY sits between its put wall 760 (-0.52%) and call wall 770 (+0.79%) with the gamma flip 777.85 1.82% above. Lean: cautious, defensive-leaning, not risk-on.
regime.momentum_caveat: Hurst and trend are not in the packet, so the MEAN_REVERT test cannot be run and is declared, not assumed. What is served says the same thing plainly: not one of the 11 sectors reads 'Momentum Building'. Seven read 'Momentum Fading - Hold, Don't Add' and three read 'Recovering'. Leadership is defensive and fading; tech and semis are weak. Every momentum nomination today runs against that tape, and negative dealer gamma makes failed breakouts more likely to reverse hard.

cross_asset.read: Bonds bid, rates falling. Bonds speaking first and saying growth worry or a flight to safety, not reflation.
Soft short-term after a 20-day rise. The dollar-squeeze scenario's main leg is not confirming right now.

cross_asset.value: close 77.10, roc5 -0.04, roc20 -1.01, below 20d avg; credit-vs-Treasuries spread -2.25
cross_asset.read: Credit lagging Treasuries by 2.25 pts over the window. Credit is not confirming equity risk appetite: a risk-off tilt.
Gold soft: not a panic bid, so the bond rally reads as growth concern more than fear.
Industrial demand signal weak: slowing, not reflating.
Rising only because gold fell faster than copper. A mechanical tilt, not a genuine growth signal; I discount it.
Oil up while copper falls: an input-cost squeeze, not demand. Supports energy relative strength, hurts margins elsewhere.

cross_asset.read: Large caps held up better over 20 days; small caps bouncing over 5 days. Young, not yet proven.

Tailwind from oil. Note oil services and nuclear themes are LAGGING: strength is in the majors, not the cyclical edge.
Strongest macro fit with falling rates. Defensive.
Mixed: insurance theme LEADING, big banks only WATCH. Falling rates are a headwind for banks.
Homebuilders theme strong (rates falling) but the sector carries a macro caution.
Sector OK but its themes (critical minerals, gold miners, agri) all LAGGING / DEEPENING. Fights falling copper and gold.

Headwind. Below 20d avg, roc20 -6.35. Semis and chip equipment LAGGING/DEEPENING; Mag7 basket AVOID with a triggered bearish wedge. Only enterprise software (LEADING) and payments (IMPROVING) hold up.
Strongest macro headwind on the board. Infra power, robotics, space LAGGING; defense tech the exception (IMPROVING).
Headwind. Social media LAGGING; gaming/streaming IMPROVING but with a bearish wedge forming.
Crypto, quantum, space, nuclear, AI infrastructure: roc20 between -15% and -32%, breadth near zero. Money is leaving the high-beta edge.

breadth.read: Mixed and young. Equal-weight vs cap-weight has been broadening for only 4 days (5d +2.54%, 20d +4.22%, 60d still -3.41%), mid-range of its 12-month band. Sector dispersion is wide: 4 groups LEADING are all defensive or energy, tech WEAKENING, comm services LAGGING; 22 of 35 themes are below their own 20d average. The broadening is the average stock catching up as mega-cap tech falls, not a broad advance. Large caps beat small caps over 20 days.
breadth.label: proxy

lean_18m: Bonds rallying, credit lagging, copper and gold soft, oil up: a slowdown with cost pressure, not a reflation. Leadership is defensive. Until credit confirms and tech stops weakening, this is a market to own quality defensives and wait on growth, not to press momentum.

agrees_on: Breadth turn is young (4 days, 60d still negative): early, not established.
Dealers short gamma: bigger swings than news deserves.
SPY 760 put wall is the near cushion; losing it can accelerate in negative gamma.
Dollar-squeeze scenario is contested and its core dollar leg is not confirming.
Trend funds are not crowded; no cut from that leg.
RSI divergences are one type only and do not line up with breadth.
differs_on: The macro-weather line calls the tape risk-on with a copper/gold reflation tilt. I read the ratio rising because gold fell faster than copper, with copper itself falling: that is not reflation.
The macro-weather line says 'broad tape'. I read the broadening as mega-cap tech falling while defensives lead, not a broad advance; credit lagging Treasuries does not confirm risk-on.
I put more weight than Crown on the credit-vs-Treasuries gap (-2.25) as a warning; Crown's data points do not speak to credit.

what_would_change_it: High-yield credit back above its 20d average and closing the gap to Treasuries: lifts sizing tone toward normal.
Technology leaving WEAKENING and semis leaving LAGGING with their breadth recovering: the growth leadership coming back.
Copper turning up on its own, not just against gold: a real reflation signal.
SPY above the 777.85 gamma flip: dealers stop amplifying moves.
Equal-weight vs cap-weight holding its broadening past its 20d average with the 60d turning positive.
Leaning further defensive: SPY losing the 760 put wall, the volatility gap widening back above its band, or Russell staying under its 2,818.62 trend-fund flip with speculators crowded long.
